newsitem.title: INDIA: Export demand helps India castorseed firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: Export demand helps India castorseed firm slightly.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery rose to 1,135/1,136 rupees per quintal from 1,132 rupees on fresh speculative buying, floor sources said.
Export demand and a fresh drop in inflow at producing areas prompted renewed bull buying.
"Indian exporters have finalised a deal to export 4,000/5,000 tonnes of castoroil at the value of $698/705 per tonne for August/September delivery," one operator said.

Meanwhile groundnut oil rose by two to three rupees to 356/357 rupees per 10 kg amid thin supplies and increased consumer buying. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by five rupees to 550 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay imported palm-oil rose by three to four rupees to 264/265 rupees per 10 kg on the back of recovery in the world market.
"In Malaysia state-owned agencies started buying palm-oil which dragged world prices upward after recent losses," one importer said.
